    (f : ι → FDRep k G) (g : κ → FDRep k G)
    [HasBiproduct f] [HasBiproduct g]
    (hcount_f :
      ∀ i₀ : ι,
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (f i₀ ≅ f i) then 1 else 0)
          =
        (∑ j, if Nonempty (f i₀ ≅ g j) then 1 else 0))
    (hcount_g :
      ∀ j₀ : κ,
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ f i) then 1 else 0)
          =
        (∑ j, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ g j) then 1 else 0)) :
    Nonempty ((⨁ f) ≅ (⨁ g))

          =

    (hcount_g :
      ∀ j₀ : κ,
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ f i) then 1 else 0)
          =
        (∑ j, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ g j) then 1 else 0)) :

name: FDRep.char_biproduct

lemma char_biproduct {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → FDRep k G) :
    (Limits.biproduct f).character = ∑ i, (f i).character

name: FDRep.char_biproduct_option

lemma char_biproduct_option {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (S : FDRep k G) (K : ι → FDRep k G) :
    (Limits.biproduct (Option.rec S K)).character
      = S.character + (Limits.biproduct K).character

name: FDRep.char_dual_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_dual_apply
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    (V : FDRep k G) (g : G) :
    V.dual.character g = V.character g⁻¹

name: FDRep.char_eq_of_isConj
statement:
lemma char_eq_of_isConj
    (V : FDRep k G) {x y : G} (h : IsConj x y) :
    V.character x = V.character y

statement: lemma char_eq_of_iso {V W : FDRep k G} (i : V ≅ W) : V.character = W.character

name: FDRep.char_eq_zero_of_IsZero

lemma char_eq_zero_of_IsZero {V : FDRep k G} (hV : Limits.IsZero V) :

name: FDRep.char_inv_conj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_inv_conj (V : FDRep k G) (g x : G) :
    V.character (x⁻¹ * g * x) = V.character g

name: FDRep.char_lift
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_lift
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, ρ.ρ x = 1)

    (FDRep.lift ρ K hK).character (QuotientGroup.mk' K g) =

name: FDRep.char_linHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_linHom_apply
    (V W : FDRep k G) (g : G) :
    (linHom V W).character g = V.character g⁻¹ * W.character g

name: FDRep.char_prod
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_prod
    (V W : FDRep k G) :
    (V.prod W).character = V.character + W.character

name: FDRep.char_res
statement:
lemma char_res
    (ρ : FDRep k G) (I : Subgroup G) :
    (FDRep.res ρ I).character = ρ.character ∘ Subtype.val

name: FDRep.char_res_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_res_apply
    (ρ : FDRep k G) (I : Subgroup G) (y : I) :
    (FDRep.res ρ I).character y = ρ.character (y : G)

name: FDRep.char_transport

lemma char_transport

name: FDRep.char_transport_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_transport_apply
    {G₁ : Type v} {G₂ : Type w} [Monoid G₁] [Monoid G₂]
    (e : G₁ ≃* G₂) (V : FDRep k G₁) (g : G₂) :

name: FDRep.char_trivial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_trivial
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (G : Type v) [Monoid G] :

name: FDRep.exists_iso_biprod_of_splitMono

lemma exists_iso_biprod_of_splitMono
    {G : Type v} [Monoid G]

name: FDRep.exists_simple_decomposition

theorem exists_simple_decomposition

name: FDRep.exists_simple_subobject
statement:
theorem exists_simple_subobject
    {k : Type u} [Field k]

name: FDRep.end_eq_smul_id_of_simple
statement:
lemma end_eq_smul_id_of_simple
   {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
   {G : Type v} [Monoid G]
   (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ] :
   ∀ f : ρ ⟶ ρ, ∃ a : k, f = a • 𝟙 ρ

name: FDRep.finrank_end_cast_ne_zero_of_simple
statement:
lemma finrank_end_cast_ne_zero_of_simple
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]

name: FDRep.finrank_end_ne_zero_of_simple
statement:
lemma finrank_end_ne_zero_of_simple
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type v} [Monoid G]
    (S : FDRep k G) [Simple S] :

name: FDRep.finrank_hom_eq_zero_of_not_iso_simple

lemma finrank_hom_eq_zero_of_not_iso_simple

name: FDRep.finrank_hom_simple
statement:
lemma finrank_hom_simple
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]

    (S T : FDRep k G) [Simple S] [Simple T] :

name: FDRep.finrank_hom_to_biproduct_simple
statement:
lemma finrank_hom_to_biproduct_simple

    (S : FDRep k G) [Simple S]

name: FDRep.hom_eq_zero_of_not_iso_simple
statement:
lemma hom_eq_zero_of_not_iso_simple
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type v} [Monoid G]

name: FDRep.hom_subsingleton_of_not_iso_simple

lemma lift_simple_of_simple
    {k : Type u} [Field k]

    (ρ : FDRep k G) (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]

name: FDRep.linearMap_id_ne_zero_of_simple

name: FDRep.nontrivial_of_simple
statement:
theorem nontrivial_of_simple
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {G : Type v} [Monoid G]

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.actionHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma actionHom_eq_zero_iff [Fintype G]

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.actionHom_eq_zero_of_biproduct
statement:
lemma actionHom_eq_zero_of_biproduct
    [Fintype G] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]

    (hS : ∀ i, ClassFun.action f (S i) = 0) :

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.actionHom_is_scalar
statement:
lemma actionHom_is_scalar [Fintype G] [IsAlgClosed k]
  (f : ClassFun k G) (V : FDRep k G) [Simple V] :
    ∃ lambda : k, actionHom f V = lambda • 𝟙 V

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.actionHom_naturality
statement:
lemma actionHom_naturality [Fintype G]
    (f : ClassFun k G) {A B : FDRep k G} (α : A ⟶ B) :
    actionHom f A ≫ α = α ≫ actionHom f B

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.action_comm
statement:
lemma action_comm [Fintype G] (f : ClassFun k G) (V : FDRep k G) (h : G) :
    action f V ∘ₗ V.ρ h = V.ρ h ∘ₗ action f V

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.action_eq_zero_iff_of_iso
statement:
lemma action_eq_zero_iff_of_iso [Fintype G]
    {V W : FDRep k G}
    (f : ClassFun k G) (e : V ≅ W) :
    action f V = 0 ↔ action f W = 0

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.action_naturality
statement:
lemma action_naturality
    [Fintype G]
    (f : ClassFun k G)
    {V W : FDRep k G}
    (α : V ⟶ W) :
    FDRep.homToLinearMap α ∘ₗ ClassFun.action f V =
      ClassFun.action f W ∘ₗ FDRep.homToLinearMap α

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.action_zero_of_biproduct
statement:
lemma action_zero_of_biproduct
    [Fintype G] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (f : ClassFun k G) (S : ι → FDRep k G)
    (hS : ∀ i, ClassFun.action f (S i) = 0) :
    ClassFun.action f (biproduct S) = 0

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.action_zero_of_iso
statement:
lemma action_zero_of_iso
    [Fintype G]
    (f : ClassFun k G)
    {A B : FDRep k G}
    (e : A ≅ B)
    (hB : ClassFun.action f B = 0) :
    ClassFun.action f A = 0

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.trace_action
statement:
lemma trace_action [Fintype G] (f : ClassFun k G) (V : FDRep k G) :
    LinearMap.trace k V (action f V) = ∑ g : G, f g * V.character g⁻¹

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.trace_action_eq_scalar_mul_finrank
statement:
lemma trace_action_eq_scalar_mul_finrank
    [Fintype G] (f : ClassFun k G) (V : FDRep k G)
    (lambda : k) (h : actionHom f V = lambda • 𝟙 V) :
    LinearMap.trace k V (action f V) =
      lambda * (Module.finrank k V : k)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.compLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compLinearMap_apply
    {R : Type*}
    [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid k] [Module R k]
    (φ : H →* G) (f : ClassFun k G) :
    compLinearMap (k := k) (R := R) φ f = f.comp φ

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.comp_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_add [Add k]
    (f g : ClassFun k G) (φ : H →* G) :
    (f + g).comp φ = f.comp φ + g.comp φ

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_apply
    (f : ClassFun k G) (φ : H →* G) (h : H) :
    f.comp φ h = f (φ h)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.comp_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_comp
    {L : Type*} [Group L]
    (f : ClassFun k G) (φ : H →* G) (ψ : L →* H) :
    (f.comp φ).comp ψ = f.comp (φ.comp ψ)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.comp_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_id (f : ClassFun k G) :
    f.comp (MonoidHom.id G) = f

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.comp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_smul
    {R : Type*} [SMul R k]
    (a : R) (f : ClassFun k G) (φ : H →* G) :
    (a • f).comp φ = a • f.comp φ

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.comp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_zero [Zero k] (φ : H →* G) :
    (0 : ClassFun k G).comp φ = 0

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivOfMulEquiv_apply
    (e : H ≃* G) (f : ClassFun k G) (h : H) :
    equivOfMulEquiv (k := k) e f h = f (e h)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma equivOfMulEquiv_symm_apply
    (e : H ≃* G) (f : ClassFun k H) (g : G) :
    (equivOfMulEquiv (k := k) e).symm f g = f (e.symm g)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.inflate_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma inflate_apply
    {K : Subgroup G} [K.Normal]
    (f : ClassFun k (G ⧸ K)) (g : G) :
    inflate f g = f (QuotientGroup.mk' K g)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.postcompLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma postcompLinearMap_apply
    {R : Type*}
    [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid k] [AddCommMonoid l]
    [Module R k] [Module R l]
    (F : k →ₗ[R] l) (f : ClassFun k G) :
    postcompLinearMap (G := G) F f = f.postcomp F

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.postcomp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma postcomp_apply
    (f : ClassFun k G) (F : k → l) (g : G) :
    f.postcomp F g = F (f g)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.postcomp_comp
statement:
lemma postcomp_comp
    {m : Type*}
    (f : ClassFun k G) (F : k → l) (Q : l → m) :
    (f.postcomp F).postcomp Q =
      f.postcomp (Q ∘ F)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.postcomp_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma postcomp_id (f : ClassFun k G) :
    f.postcomp id = f

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.res_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma res_add [Add k]
    (K : Subgroup G) (f g : ClassFun k G) :
    res K (f + g) = res K f + res K g

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.res_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma res_apply
    (K : Subgroup G) (f : ClassFun k G) (x : K) :
    res K f x = f (x : G)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.res_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma res_smul
    {R : Type*} [SMul R k]
    (K : Subgroup G) (a : R) (f : ClassFun k G) :
    res K (a • f) = a • res K f

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.res_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma res_zero [Zero k] (K : Subgroup G) :
    res K (0 : ClassFun k G) = 0

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem char_apply (V : FDRep k G) (g : G) :
    ClassFun.character V g = V.character g

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_biproduct
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_biproduct
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (V : ι → FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character (Limits.biproduct V)
      =
    ∑ i, ClassFun.character (V i)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_dual
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_dual (V : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character (V.dual) = ClassFun.involution (ClassFun.character V)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_eq_of_iso
statement:
lemma char_eq_of_iso
    {V W : FDRep k G} (e : V ≅ W) :
    ClassFun.character V = ClassFun.character W

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_linHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_linHom (V W : FDRep k G) (g : G) :
    ClassFun.character (FDRep.linHom V W) g =
      V.character g⁻¹ * W.character g

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_mul_comm
statement:
theorem char_mul_comm (V : FDRep k G) (g : G) (h : G) :
    ClassFun.character V (h * g) = ClassFun.character V (g * h)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_one (V : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character V 1 = Module.finrank k V

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_prod
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_prod (V W : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character (V.prod W) = ClassFun.character V + ClassFun.character W

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_tensor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem char_tensor
    (V W : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character (FDRep.tensor V W)
      =
    ClassFun.character V * ClassFun.character W

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_trivial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_trivial
    (k : Type u) (G : Type v)
    [Field k] [Group G] :
    ClassFun.character (FDRep.trivial k G) = (1 : ClassFun k G)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.res_ofChar
statement:
@[simp] theorem res_ofChar
    {H : Subgroup G} (V : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) H (ClassFun.character V)
      =
    ClassFun.character (FDRep.res (k := k) (G := G) V H)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.char_eq_sum_simples
statement:
theorem char_eq_sum_simples
    [Finite G] [NeZero (Nat.card G : k)]
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (S : ι → FDRep k G)
      (_ : Fintype ι) (_ : ∀ i, Simple (S i)),
      ClassFun.character V =
        ∑ i : ι, ClassFun.character (S i)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.character_mem_span_irreducibles
statement:
theorem character_mem_span_irreducibles
    [Finite G] [NeZero (Nat.card G : k)]
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character V ∈
      Submodule.span ℤ
        (irreducibleCharacterSet k G)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.character_mem_span_irreducibles_of_eq
statement:
theorem character_mem_span_irreducibles_of_eq
    [Finite G] [NeZero (Nat.card G : k)]
    (φ : ClassFun k G)
    (h_rep : ∃ V : FDRep k G,
      φ = ClassFun.character V) :
    φ ∈
      Submodule.span ℤ
        (irreducibleCharacterSet k G)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.sum_eq_sum_conjClasses
statement:
theorem sum_eq_sum_conjClasses
    [Fintype G]
    (f : ClassFun k G) :
    ∑ g : G, f g =
      ∑ c : ConjClasses G,
        (Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (ConjAct G) c.out) : k) * f c.out

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.sum_inv_card_centralizer
statement:
theorem sum_inv_card_centralizer
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Fintype G]
    (f : ClassFun k G) :
    ∑ c : ConjClasses G,
        (Nat.card
          (Subgroup.centralizer ({c.out} : Set G)) : k)⁻¹ * f c.out
      =
    (Fintype.card G : k)⁻¹ * ∑ g : G, f g

name: LinearMap.trace_pi_diag
statement:
lemma LinearMap.trace_pi_diag (f : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[k] V i) :
    LinearMap.trace k ((i : ι) → V i)
        (LinearMap.pi fun i => f i ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj i)
      =
    ∑ i, LinearMap.trace k (V i) (f i)

name: Representation.average_char_eq_finrank_invariants
statement:
theorem average_char_eq_finrank_invariants
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    [Fintype G] [CharZero k]
    {V : Type w}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [Module.Finite k V]
    (ρ : Representation k G V) :
    ((Fintype.card G : k)⁻¹) *
        (∑ g : G, ρ.character g)
      =
    (Module.finrank k ρ.invariants : k)

name: Representation.char_directSum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_directSum (ρ : (i : ι) → Representation k G (V i)) (g : G) :
    (Representation.directSum ρ).character g = ∑ i, (ρ i).character g

name: Representation.char_equiv
statement:
lemma char_equiv
    {ρ : Representation k G V} {σ : Representation k G W}
     (h : Representation.Equiv ρ σ) (g : G) :
    ρ.character g = σ.character g

name: Representation.char_prod
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_prod [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Finite k W]
  (ρ : Representation k G V) (σ : Representation k G W) :
    (ρ.prod σ).character = ρ.character + σ.character

name: Representation.character_def
statement:
lemma character_def (ρ : Representation k G V) (g : G) :
  character ρ g = LinearMap.trace k V (ρ g)

name: Representation.ofMulAction_trace
statement:
lemma ofMulAction_trace
    {X : Type*} [Finite X] [MulAction G X] (g : G) :
    LinearMap.trace k (MonoidAlgebra k X)
        (Representation.ofMulAction k G X g)
      =
    (Nat.card {x : X // g • x = x} : k)

name: Tengoku.Brauerinduction.ClassFun.action_eq_zero_of_pairing_eq_zero
statement:
lemma action_eq_zero_of_pairing_eq_zero
    [Fintype G] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {κ : Type} (S : κ → FDRep k G)
    [hS : ∀ i, CategoryTheory.Simple (S i)]
    (f : ClassFun k G)

name: FDRep.conjMap_rho_apply_of_mem_normal
statement:
lemma conjMap_rho_apply_of_mem_normal
    (A I : Subgroup G) [haN : A.Normal] (hAI : A ≤ I)
    (g : G) (σ : FDRep k I)
    (a : A)
    (v : (FDRep.conjMap (k := k) I g σ)) :
    let Ig : Subgroup G := I.map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom
    let hAIg : A ≤ Ig := FDRep.le_conjMap_of_normal A I hAI g
    let aIg : Ig := ⟨(a : G), hAIg a.2⟩
    let a_conj_val : G := g⁻¹ * (a : G) * g
    let h_mem_A : a_conj_val ∈ A := by
      simpa [a_conj_val] using
         Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem' haN (a : G) a.2 g
    let aI : I := ⟨a_conj_val, hAI h_mem_A⟩
    (FDRep.conjMap (k := k) I g σ).ρ aIg v =
      σ.ρ aI v

name: FDRep.mackey_parameterization_inner_sum_eq_expanded
statement:
lemma mackey_parameterization_inner_sum_eq_expanded
    [Fintype G]
    (I : Subgroup G)
    (σ : FDRep k I)
    (g : G)
    (p : I × I) :
    let H : Subgroup G := mackeyIntersection I g
    (∑ i : I,
      if h : DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p * (i : G) *
          (DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p)⁻¹ ∈ I
      then
        σ.character
          ⟨DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p * (i : G) *
            (DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p)⁻¹, h⟩ *
          σ.character i⁻¹
      else 0)
    =
    (∑ h : H,
      σ.character
        (((MulAut.conj g).subgroupMap I).symm
          ⟨(h : G), h.2.2⟩)
      *
      σ.character
        (⟨(h⁻¹ : G), I.inv_mem h.2.1⟩))

name: FDRep.mackey_parameterization_inner_summand_eq_expanded
statement:
lemma mackey_parameterization_inner_summand_eq_expanded
    (I : Subgroup G)
    (σ : FDRep k I)
    (g : G)
    (p : I × I)
    (i :
      {i : I //
        DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p * (i : G) *
          (DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p)⁻¹ ∈ I}) :
    let h : mackeyIntersection I g :=
      (mackeyParameterizationInnerEquiv
        (I := I) (g := g) (p := p)) i
    σ.character
        ⟨DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p * (i.1 : G) *
          (DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p)⁻¹, i.2⟩ *
      σ.character i.1⁻¹
      =
    σ.character
        (((MulAut.conj g).subgroupMap I).symm
          ⟨(h : G), h.2.2⟩)
      *
      σ.character
        (⟨(h⁻¹ : G), I.inv_mem h.2.1⟩)

name: FDRep.mackey_product_sum_eq_card_sq_mul_expanded_sum
statement:
lemma mackey_product_sum_eq_card_sq_mul_expanded_sum
    [Fintype G]
    (I : Subgroup G)
    (σ : FDRep k I)
    (g : G) :
    let H : Subgroup G := mackeyIntersection I g
    let F : G → k := fun x =>
      ∑ i : I,
        if h : x * (i : G) * x⁻¹ ∈ I
        then σ.character ⟨x * (i : G) * x⁻¹, h⟩ * σ.character i⁻¹
        else 0
    ∑ p : I × I, F (DoubleCoset.parameterization I g p)
      =
    (Nat.card I : k) * (Nat.card I : k) *
      ∑ h : H,
        σ.character
          (((MulAut.conj g).subgroupMap I).symm
            ⟨(h : G), h.2.2⟩)
        *
        σ.character
          (⟨(h⁻¹ : G), I.inv_mem h.2.1⟩)

lemma phiSum_apply_expand [Finite G]

    (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (x : E_subgroup p a) :
    phiSum p ha x =
      ∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
        (((psiEZeta  (k := k) p ha ζ)
            ⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup (p := p) a⟩ : kˣ) : k) *
          (((psiEZeta  (k := k) p ha ζ) x : kˣ) : k)

          (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) x : kˣ) : k))
      =
    ∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
        (((psiEZeta p ha ζ)
            (⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup p a⟩ * x) : kˣ) : k)

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_card_fixedCosets
statement:
lemma f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_card_fixedCosets
    [CharZero k] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) (s : G) (hs_sing : IsPSingular p s) (h_comm : Commute a s) :
    f (k := k) p a (a * s) =
    (Nat.card { c : ↥(centralizer ({a} : Set G)) ⧸ (P_in_Z p a : Subgroup _) //
      (⟨s, fun y hy => by rcases hy with rfl; exact h_comm.eq⟩ :
        ↥(centralizer ({a} : Set G))) • c = c } : k)

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_sum
statement:
lemma f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_sum
    [CharZero k] [Fintype G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) (s : G) (hs_sing : IsPSingular p s) (h_comm : Commute a s) :
    f (k := k) (p := p) a (a * s) =
    (Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) : k)⁻¹ *
      ((Finset.univ.filter
          (fun x => x ∈ centralizer ({a} : Set G) ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a)).card : k)  *
      (orderOf a : k)

    BrauerLinGen.inducedCharacter i g
      =
    (FDRep.indLin i.H i.ψ).character g

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanLin.exists_decomposition
statement:
theorem BrauerSpanLin.exists_decomposition
    {χ : ClassFun k G}
    (hχ : χ ∈ BrauerSpanLin) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (ns : ι → ℤ) (Hs : ι → Subgroup G)
      (ψs : ∀ i, Hs i →* kˣ),
      (∀ i, IsBrauerElementary (Hs i)) ∧
      χ = ∑ i, (ns i) • ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin (Hs i) (ψs i))
